label: Get your SMS activity aggregated over a period of time
description: Retrieve an aggregated report of your transactional SMS activity over a specified time period, including counts for requests, delivered, hard bounces, soft bounces, blocked, unsubscribed, replied, accepted, rejected, and skipped messages. Filter by date range using `startDate` and `endDate` (both required together, YYYY-MM-DD format) or by a number of past `days` (not compatible with date range). You can further narrow results by `tag`. If no date filter is provided, the report covers all available data and returns the auto-detected date range.

startDate.description: **Mandatory if endDate is used.** Starting date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the report

endDate.description: **Mandatory if startDate is used.** Ending date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the report

days.description: Number of days in the past including today (positive integer). **Not compatible with startDate and endDate**

accepted.description: Number of accepted SMS for the timeframe

blocked.description: Number of blocked contact for the timeframe

delivered.description: Number of delivered SMS for the timeframe

hardBounces.description: Number of hardbounces for the timeframe

rejected.description: Number of rejected SMS for the timeframe

replied.description: Number of answered SMS for the timeframe

requests.description: Number of requests for the timeframe

skipped.description: Number of skipped SMS for the timeframe

softBounces.description: Number of softbounces for the timeframe

unsubscribed.description: Number of unsubscription for the timeframe
